preconditions.description: The graph is connected and has between 1 and 3 * 10^5 vertices and between 0 and 3 * 10^5 edges.
Each edge weight is between 1 and 10^9.
There are no self-loops in the graph.

preconditions.expression: no two edges connect the same pair of vertices
preconditions.description: There are no multiple edges between the same pair of vertices.

postconditions.expression: output_weight == min(total_weight for total_weight, _ in all_trees)
postconditions.description: The output contains the minimum total weight of any shortest-path tree from the given start vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(edge in tree_edges for edge in output_edges)
postconditions.description: The output contains all edges that are part of the shortest-path tree.
The output forms a tree structure.
The output contains the correct edges that form the shortest-path tree.
